guide: Open the Start sheet and type your school, your name, the class and the weight of each assessment type in the yellow cells.
Set your grade scale (the lowest average for A, B, C and D) and the alerts for averages, absences and missing work.
List your students on the Students sheet with a parent or guardian and a phone number with the country code.
Add each homework, quiz, project and test on the Assignments sheet with its maximum points.
Enter scores on the Scores sheet, one row per student per assignment. Mark missing or excused work in the Submission column.
Take attendance on the Attendance sheet: one row per student per day.
Log positive notes and issues on the Behavior Log, and every call or message on Parent Contacts.
Plan your lessons on the Lesson Plan sheet and mark them taught or moved.
Record what you buy for the class on Classroom Spending to see what the school owes you.
Check the Class Dashboard and the Charts every week, and send a ready message from the Students sheet.
Print the Progress Report, the Meeting Letter or the Permission Slip by choosing a student or a trip at the top of the sheet.

listing.title: Teacher Excel Template: Gradebook, Attendance, Lesson Plan, Parent Contacts, Missing Work Tracker, 15 Languages
listing.headline: Teacher gradebook in Excel: weighted grades, attendance, parent messages
features: Weighted gradebook with your own A-F scale
Missing work counted and tracked per student
Score needed on the final and grade curve calculators
Lesson plan, behavior log and parent contact log
Classroom spending and what the school owes you
Trip permission slip and field-trip checklist
listing.description:
Run your class from one Excel workbook: a weighted gradebook, attendance, missing work, behavior notes, parent contacts, lesson plans and your own classroom spending, with every average, grade and alert worked out for you.

Most teachers keep grades in one file, attendance on paper and parent calls in their head. Missing work slips through until the report card, and nobody adds up what you spend on the class. ClassMark puts it all in one place.

WHAT IT DOES
• Weighted term grade from homework, quizzes, projects and tests, with your own weights and A-F scale
• Missing work counts as zero and excused work is left out
• Attendance rate and absences of the last 30 days for every student
• Students at risk flagged when the average, the absences or the missing work cross your limits
• Ready WhatsApp messages for an absence, missing work, good news, a meeting or a grade update
• Printable progress report with every assignment of one student, a meeting letter and a trip permission slip
• Score needed on the final, grade curve and marking time calculators
• Lesson plan, behavior log and parent contact log with follow-up dates
• Classroom spending and what the school still owes you
• Dashboard and charts: class average, attendance, missing work, contacts and spending

YOU RECEIVE a ZIP with the workbook in 15 languages and an English copy filled with sample data. Standard .xlsx files for Microsoft Excel and LibreOffice. No macros, no subscription. Licence for one teacher.

messages.text: Hello {guardian}, {name} was absent from class today. Absences in the last 30 days: {abs30}. Please let me know if there is anything I should know.
Hello {guardian}, {name} has {missing} missing assignments in my class. Could you help {name} hand them in this week? Thank you.
Hello {guardian}, some good news: {name} has worked really well in class this week. I wanted you to know.
Hello {guardian}, I would like to meet you to talk about how {name} is doing in class. Which day suits you?
Hello {guardian}, {name}'s grade in my class is {grade} so far this term. I will send the full progress report soon.

In the last 30 days {col:students.name} was absent {col:students.abs30} times and has {col:students.missing} missing assignments. The current grade is {col:students.grade}.
Please reply with a day and time that suits you. Thank you for your support.
